table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	PayrollCode,
	Date,
	Posted,
	PostedBy,
	PostDate,
	UserCode,
	LastSaved ,
	FromDate, 
	ToDate,
	EmpID = (SELECT E.EmpID FROM EMP_Employee E WHERE E.EMPCode = EMP_Payroll.EmpCode),
	EmpCode,
	WorkDays,
	Presents, 
	Absents,
	Leaves,
	Sundays,
	Holidays,
	WorkingHours=(SELECT P.Workinghours FROM EMP_Pay P WHERE P.EMPCode = EMP_Payroll.EmpCode),
	PayType=(SELECT P.PayType FROM EMP_Pay P WHERE P.EMPCode = EMP_Payroll.EmpCode),
	HoursWorked,
	PerHourRate,
	BasicPay,
	OverTimeHours,
	OverTimeRate,
	OverTime,
	BonusPay,
	SpecialPay,
	AdditionalPay, 
	OtherPay,
	Fine,
	Penalty,
	OtherCharge,
	Advance,
	NetPayable,
	Remarks,
	Paid,
	PaidVia,
	PaymentDate,
	PaymentRefNo,
	PaymentRemarks,
	PaidBy
FROM EMP_Payroll
WHERE PayrollCode=:ai_code
